title: This Worm Shoots Slime Almost Two Feet to Trap Its Prey

scenes.text: This worm shoots slime almost two feet to trap its prey.
It's a velvet worm, a soft, legged animal from tropical forests.
Its slime cannons fire in about 65 milliseconds.
The jet travels three to five meters every second.
It lands as a tangled web that glues the prey in place.
Then the slime hardens fast, and the worm eats.
The whole attack is faster than a blink.

description:
